description: The insurgency half of the danger: bodies in the road, and they will swing at you. Warned before it lands, always, and by construction rather than by an authored line.
name: It has gone off in the street

stage.warn: Shouting, close, then the sound of somebody going into a shutter.

lines: There is a fight going on at the far end and it is not stopping.
Somebody runs past you holding a length of pipe and does not look at you.
Two people are being kept apart by four people who are also fighting.

stage.text: It has kicked off properly in {place}. Half of them do not even know who started it.
